title: Gloria (Guerrero, Missa Sancta et immaculata virginitas)
desc: Francisco Guerrero, Missa Sancta et immaculata virginitas, Gloria, before 1566. 5 voices (Superius 1º, Superius 2º, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From CRIM, Citations: The Renaissance Imitation Mass (crimproject.org, CRIM_Mass_0025_2); edited by María Elena Cuenca Rodríguez, Vincent Besson. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
